motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: The bullet that can do me in doesn't even exist yet!

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: This is my responsibility. My teammates are not to blame...

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: AK-12? Yes, we have dueled each other a few times in the past. But if we are to come face-to-face again, I hope she'll be prepared for what's to come.

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: I wouldn't have had to waste my time on being repaired if I could have a bottle of decent booze.

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: I'm back. Why is everyone such a lightweight?

motions.name: login
motions.line: All on-duty personnel is lined up. We can now get on with our work.

motions.name: login
motions.line: All on-duty personnel is lined up. We can now get on with our work.

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: This is the strongest liquor you have? I thought it was just water in some fancy packaging... There's no way this can tide us over a whole day of club activities.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: Just this once, let's bring out all the stockpile of the Vodka Club, so that everyone can drink to their heart's content!

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: Only the truly powerful has what it takes to join my perfect team...so don't forget my club members.

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: I don't have enough booze with me to kill all this time.

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: The Vodka Club has increased in size again. Let's test out how the new members carry their alcohol first.

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: No wonder you've become such a good drinker lately, so you have an ulterior motive...<> Still, I understand that this is a show of sincerity.<> It'll be nice to have a good drinking partner who appreciates a lovely drink from now on. It's decided then.

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: We don't need watery drinks at home⁠—you should've known. So now I'm confiscating all this booze with low alcohol content.
